description: Defines the IAVInput interface and related notification structures for managing AV input devices, signals, and configurations within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IAVInput
classes.description: Interface for AV input device management, including device configuration, notifications, and data retrieval.

classes.name: InputDevice
classes.description: Represents an AV input device with id, locator, and connection status.

classes.name: SuccessResult
classes.description: Indicates success or failure of operations.

classes.name: IDevicesChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification callback for device connection changes.

classes.name: ISignalChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification callback for signal status changes.

classes.name: IInputStatusChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification callback for input status changes.

classes.name: IVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
classes.description: Notification callback for video stream info updates.

classes.name: IGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
classes.description: Notification callback for game feature status updates.

classes.name: IAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
classes.description: Notification callback for AV infoframe content type changes.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the AV input device with the provided service.

methods.name: RegisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for device connection/disconnection events.

methods.name: UnregisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a device connection/disconnection callback.

methods.name: RegisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for signal status changes.

methods.name: UnregisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a signal status change callback.

methods.name: RegisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for input status changes.

methods.name: UnregisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters an input status change callback.

methods.name: RegisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for video stream info updates.

methods.name: UnregisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a video stream info update callback.

methods.name: RegisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for game feature status updates.

methods.name: UnregisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a game feature status update callback.

methods.name: RegisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for AV infoframe content type updates.

methods.name: UnregisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters an AV infoframe content type update callback.

methods.name: NumberOfInputs
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available AV inputs.

methods.name: WriteEDID
methods.description: Writes a new EDID value to a specified port.

methods.name: ReadEDID
methods.description: Reads the current EDID value from a specified port.

methods.name: GetRawSPD
methods.description: Retrieves raw SPD infoFrame data for a port.

methods.name: GetSPD
methods.description: Retrieves SPD infoFrame data for a port.

methods.name: SetEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: GetEdidVersion
methods.description: Gets the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: SetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Sets the Allm support bit in EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Gets the Allm support bit in EDID for a port.

methods.name: SetVRRSupport
methods.description: Sets VRR support in EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetVRRSupport
methods.description: Gets VRR support status from EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetHdmiVersion
methods.description: Retrieves maximum HDMI version supported for a port.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets audio mixer levels.

methods.name: StartInput
methods.description: Activates a specific input port.

methods.name: StopInput
methods.description: Deactivates the current input port.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video window dimensions for an input.

methods.name: CurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Retrieves current video mode for an input.

methods.name: ContentProtected
methods.description: Checks if content is protected on an input.

methods.name: GetSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves list of supported game features.

methods.name: GetGameFeatureStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status of a game feature.

methods.name: GetVRRFrameRate
methods.description: Retrieves current VRR frame rate for an input.
